Lead 2026-10-05 (slice 5 protocol gaps):
1. QueryRow.matched becomes Option[TrialKey], like PreviewRow.matched. A query with no match carries the eyes4s UnmatchedKind reason, and a not-admitted query carries its admission disposition. Studio never re-derives a would-be match. This goes in the S3.7 protocol minor (1.13 in landing order). Until then the real backend refuses  as Unavailable(Run), and the agreement test stays out of Served.
2 and 3. Scale-dependent and grouped scalars (grandD, participant M/B/D, group means and n, pairedN, the n range) leave ResultSummary. They come from report(run, spec, scale) (protocol 1.11, lane-s26). The spec is the reporting spec Compare shows (S8.7's selected spec, which defaults to the one bound to the first figure). The scale is the trail's scale. ResultSummary keeps only scale-free, ungrouped facts and the by-scale vectors. The Compare summary migrates to report(); that migration is a separate bead for the Compare lane.
